title: README: name the commands and flags it leaves out
body: The README never mentions foam reclaim, foam log, foam dep rm and dep tree, init --prefix, sync --remote, setup claude --remove, claim and unclaim --force, create --label and --body, or prime --limit, and foam search only appears inside the prime sample. None of this contradicts the binary; the README is a narrative and the --help is the reference. Decide whether a short command table belongs at the end, or whether the gaps stay deliberate.
